<?php

fscanf(STDIN, "%d\n", $n);
$a = trim(fgets(STDIN));

$count = [
    2 => 0,
    3 => 0,
    5 => 0,
    7 => 0
];

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $d = intval($a[$i]);
    switch ($d) {
        case 0:
        case 1:
            break;
        case 2:
            $count[2]++;
            break;
        case 3:
            $count[3]++;
            break;
        case 4:
            $count[2] += 3;
            $count[3]++;
            break;
        case 5:
            $count[5]++;
            break;
        case 6:
            $count[3]++;
            $count[5]++;
            break;
        case 7:
            $count[7]++;
            break;
        case 8:
            $count[2] += 3;
            $count[7]++;
            break;
        case 9:
            $count[2]++;
            $count[3] += 2;
            $count[7]++;
            break;
    }
}

$output = str_repeat('7', $count[7]) . str_repeat('5', $count[5]) . str_repeat('3', $count[3]) . str_repeat('2', $count[2]);
echo $output . "\n";

?>

source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Output a maximum possible integer satisfying the conditions above. There should be no zeroes and ones in this number decimal representation.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 15) — the number of digits in a. The second line contains n digits of a. There is at least one digit in a that is larger than 1. Number a may possibly contain leading zeroes.
